approved_decision.rule: Generate exactly 2 reviewed G-ID-first options for each of the 40 locked Wave 04 semantic slots. Generation produces review options only.

governance_decisions.decision: Use NATIVE_PRIMITIVE_CANDIDATE as default lane; do not infer productive morphology from -VAN, final -I, PAR-, VAM-/VAMA-, SAR- or prior lexical families.

Each option exposes slot ID, blueprint concept reference, G-ID sequence, IPA, governed romanization, phonotactic result, exact-collision result, near-collision distance and morphology-false-friend result.
Reject exact collisions against 33 recovered forms and all 140 authored registry entries through Wave 03; near collisions require explicit review.
This gate resolves no HOLD seed and creates no semantic authority beyond the approved blueprint slots.
After generation prepare a separate Wave 04 human selection gate; generated options receive no registry status, HNK3000 credit, FROZEN authority, curriculum binding or runtime use.
